title: PropertyData - Property Market Analytics
key_point: Aggregates portal asking prices, PPD, EPC floor area, rents, yields, demand, forecasts, planning, flood, schools, council tax, census; from GBP14/month.

title: Valuation - PropertyData
key_point: Price-per-sq-ft valuation; inputs floor area, beds, condition, finish, outdoor space, parking, age; outputs range, comparables, confidence level.

title: Nimbus Maps - Property Intelligence Platform
key_point: 2,000+ data sources, 30m+ comparables, ownership, planning, constraints, EA flood, grid/EV, footfall for surveyors, agents, developers.

title: Searchland - Land sourcing and planning data
key_point: 30 years planning data daily-updated, ownership, constraints, PTAL, flood, green belt, Rightmove comps weekly; 2,000+ professionals.

title: LandTech / LandInsight
key_point: Site-finding with planning policy, ownership, Hometrack comparables, PTAL, biodiversity, utilities; used by 5,000+ UK developers incl. CBRE, Savills, JLL.

title: Chimnie - free property reports
key_point: Free value-range, location-score and risk reports for every British home; 150,000+ active users; B2B partners incl. Barclays.

title: Sprift - UK Property Data, EPC Ratings and Reports
key_point: 420+ data points on 30m+ UK homes; white-label reports, comparables engine, prospecting and API for agents, surveyors, brokers, conveyancers.

title: Instant property valuation reporting - Hometrack
key_point: GBP19.95 AVM report: estimate, calibrated confidence level, range, comparables, Zoopla demand data, past transactions; withheld if confidence too low.

title: About us - Hometrack
key_point: Leading UK lender AVM; contributes to nearly all ~1.4m annual mortgage approvals; part of Houseful with Zoopla and Alto.

title: How Much is Your Home Worth? Instant House Valuation - Zoopla
key_point: Estimate from PPD and Zoopla listing/sales data on 34m homes; cannot see condition or improvements; 'starting point', not street-level accurate.

title: See UK Sold House Prices Online - Rightmove
key_point: Land Registry/RoS sold prices updated 20th monthly with past listing photos and floorplans; last two months incomplete; instant valuation promoted.

title: Crystal Roof - neighbourhood research
key_point: Free; 2.6M postcodes; crime, noise, demographics, affluence, transport incl. Tube reliability, amenities, schools, air pollution, flood.

title: Crime report SW9 8EH, Brixton Road
key_point: 389 crimes per 1,000 at-risk population, score 10/10, vs Lambeth 123; 13 crime types, 2011-2025 trend, police.uk source.

title: Transport report SW9 8EH
key_point: Transport shown as 9/9 score, TfL zone 2, nearby stations with walking distance and lines; no journey-time or crowding data.

title: Plumplot - UK maps and statistics
key_point: Interactive maps of house prices, crime, census, salaries, home features and energy efficiency for England and Wales by region to postcode.

title: London house prices - Plumplot
key_point: London Sep25-Aug26: mean GBP653k, median 500k, -5% YoY, sales -27.9%; RM1 1 GBP234k to SW1X 7 GBP12.8m; price/earnings 11.7.

title: SW9 8EH postcode data - Get the Data
key_point: Open-data postcode page: deprivation percentile, census geographies, elevation, NaPTAN stops/stations, food hygiene, PPD, all with cited sources.

title: About the Price Paid Data
key_point: Fields: price, date, postcode, type D/S/T/F/O, new-build, tenure, category A/B; excludes non-market transfers; 2-week to 2-month lag.

title: Find an energy certificate
key_point: EPC/DEC lookup by postcode, street or certificate number for England, Wales, NI; the source of floor area used by valuation tools.

title: Check long term flood risk
key_point: Area-level risk from rivers/sea, surface water, reservoirs, groundwater plus climate outlook; not property-level, excludes drain/pipe flooding.

title: About - data.police.uk
key_point: Crimes snapped to anonymous points (8+ addresses), month-only dates, 14 categories; geocoding accuracy 60-97% by force.

title: Public Transport Accessibility Levels
key_point: PTAL 0-6b on 100m grid from walk time, reliability, service count, waits; ignores speed/crowding; WebCAT adds travel-time maps. London-only.

title: StreetCheck - has anyone used this to influence buying choices
key_point: Posters: StreetCheck repackages police.uk/census; crime counts alarm without context; visit at different times, ask residents; tools as first indicator only.

title: Rightmove vs Zoopla valuation
key_point: Estimates diverge widely (58.6% vs 106%; GBP1.09m vs 1.33m vs agent 1.5m); wrong attributes and stale anchors; buyers decide price.

title: Are sold prices always correct on Rightmove?
key_point: Odd PPD prices explained by shared ownership stakes, buy-outs, part-exchange, data errors (semi recorded as GBP65k leasehold flat).

title: Material information rules axed overnight as new consumer act takes precedence
key_point: NTSELAT withdrew material-information guidance 9 May 2025 as DMCC Act 2024 replaced CPRs; duty remains, CMA can fine; confusion.

title: 'Thousands of agents' not complying with material info rules
key_point: Moverly audit of ~523k listings: tenure missing 4% (20.7k), parking missing 25% (133k); worse in Edinburgh, Glasgow, Newcastle.

title: Agents are anti-AI when it comes to property valuations - agent poll
key_point: Alto poll of 250 agents: 87% distrust AVMs; ~1/3 adjust by GBP10-20k; AVMs miss extensions, lofts, condition; yet 39% rely heavily.

title: New Hometrack platform to help agents sharpen up valuations
key_point: Hometrack Comparables: attributes, year built, EPC, floor area, sales history, tenure, rental comps, refreshed every 30 days via API.

title: Rightmove to offer home owners valuation tool from May onwards
key_point: Track My Property ML on sold prices, listings and feedback; shows range not figure; exact valuation deferred to local agents.

title: Rightmove steps up drive to 'digitise' UK property market with new tool
key_point: Equity tracker inside Instant Online Valuation: real-time value, mortgage end date, remortgage options, equity and borrowing capacity.

title: Valuation leads jump for agents, says Rightmove
key_point: Rightmove valuation leads to agents up 55% in Jan-May 2026 YoY; online estimate precedes in-person agent valuation.

title: Moverly for agents
key_point: Material-information and digital property pack provider; page rendered no readable content (JavaScript only).

title: Locrating
key_point: School catchment and area mapping tool; fetch returned HTTP 403, not read.

title: StreetCheck
key_point: Domain now 301-redirects to Crystal Roof (observed October 2026).
